freeTextLead: Describe everything freely: work done, quantities, units, time, location, and notes. The system will suggest a structure, but it only becomes a fact once you confirm it.
suggestionReviewIntro: These are suggestions. Confirm only what is correct. Unconfirmed suggestions are not saved as facts.
